translations.text: And the word of the Lord came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham and Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
Let all the people hear, and let the earth give heed, and all who are on it; and let the Lord God be a witness among you, as a testimony of the Lord from his holy house.
For behold, the Lord is coming out of his place, and he will come down and go up on the high places of the earth.
And the mountains will be shaken under his feet, and the valleys will melt like wax before the fire, and like water rushing down its slope.

All this will happen because of the ungodliness of Jacob and because of the sin of the house of Judah. What is the ungodliness of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what is the sin of the house of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
And I will make Samaria like a hut for guarding fruit in a field, and like a place for planting a vineyard. I will hurl her stones down into the depths and lay bare her foundations.

And all her carved images will be cut down, and all her hires will be burned with fire, and all her idols will be smashed to destruction. For she gathered them from the hire of harlotry, and from the hires of harlotry she has returned.
Therefore she will wail and mourn, and she will go about naked and barefoot. She will wail like demons, and mourn like the daughters of dragons.
For her wound has taken hold, for it has come as far as Judah, and has drawn near as far as the gates of my people, as far as Jerusalem.
Now, you who are in Gath, do not exalt yourselves, and you who are in Enakim, do not rebuild. From the house of mockery, sprinkle dust on yourselves for your mockery.
She who dwells well in her cities did not come out, she who dwells in Senaar. Mourn for the house next to her; it will receive from you a painful wound.
Who, dwelling well, has begun to be in pains? For evil has come down from the Lord upon the gates of Jerusalem.
The noise of chariots and horsemen! She who dwells in Lachish is the beginning of her sin, that is, of the daughter of Zion's sin, for the ungodly deeds of Israel were found in you.
Therefore they will give up those who are cast out, as far as the inheritance of the Gittites. The houses of vanity have become empty for the kings of Israel.
Until they bring the heirs to her who dwells in Lachish, the inheritance will reach as far as Adullam; the glory of the daughter of Israel will come.
Now make yourself bald and shave your head for your pampered children. Widen the baldness of your widowhood like a vulture, for they have been carried away captive from you.
They became plotters of toil and doers of evil on their beds, and as soon as it was day they carried it out, for they did not lift up their hands to God.
And they coveted fields, and seized orphans, and did violence to households, and seized people and their houses, a man and his inheritance.

Therefore the Lord says this: Behold, I have planned evil against this family, from which you will not be able to lift your necks, and you will not be able to walk upright at once, for it is an evil time, and it will come.

On that day this proverb will be taken up against you, and they will lament over you with a mournful song and say, 'We have been made utterly wretched. The portion of my people has been measured with a cord, and there was no one to stop it or turn it back; our fields have been measured out.'
Therefore you will have no one to cast the measuring cord over a portion in the assembly of the Lord.
Do not weep with tears, and do not shed tears over these things, for reproach will not depart.
He who says: "The house of Jacob has angered the Spirit of the Lord." If these are his deeds, are his words not good with him, and do they not walk rightly?
And formerly my people rose up as an enemy against his peace; they stripped off his skin to take away hope, to the crushing of war.
The leaders of my people will be cast out of the houses they delighted in; they were driven out because of the wickedness of their deeds. Draw near to the everlasting mountains.
Arise and go, for this is not your rest. Because of uncleanness you have been utterly corrupted.
You were pursued when no one was pursuing; he established a spirit of falsehood. He called [?] you to the wine of drunkenness, and it will come from the drop of this people.

Jacob will surely be gathered, all of him; I will surely wait for the remnant of Israel. I will bring back their returning ones together, like sheep in distress, like a flock in the middle of its fold, and they will burst out from among men.
They broke through the breach before them, and passed through the gate, and went out by it, and their king went out before them, and now the Lord will lead them.
And he will say: "Hear now, rulers of the house of Jacob and remnant of the house of Israel: is it not your task to know justice,
you who hate good and love evil, who tear their skin off them and their flesh off their bones?
As they devoured the flesh of my people, stripped off their skin, broke their bones, and threw them out limb by limb like flesh into a cauldron [?] and like pieces of meat into a pot,
so they will cry out to the Lord, and he will not hear them. He will turn his face away from them at that time, because they did evil in their deeds against them.

This is what the Lord says about the prophets who lead my people astray, who bite with their teeth and preach peace to them, and when nothing was put into their mouths, they stirred up war against them:
Therefore you will have night instead of a vision, and darkness instead of divination. The sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will grow dark over them.
Those who see visions will be put to shame, and the diviners will be held in contempt, and all of them will speak evil against them, for there will be [?] no one who listens to them.
Surely I will fill myself with strength by the Spirit of the Lord, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his ungodliness and to Israel his sins.
Hear this, leaders of the house of Jacob and you remnant of the house of Israel, you who abhor justice and twist everything that is right,
you who build Zion with blood and Jerusalem with falsehood.
Her leaders judged for bribes, her priests gave answers for pay, and her prophets divined for silver. Yet they relied on the Lord and said: "Is the Lord not with us? No evil will come upon us."
Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become like a hut for guarding fruit, and the mountain of the house of the Lord like a forest thicket.
And in the last days the mountain of the Lord will be made visible, established on the top of the mountains. It will be raised higher than all the hills, and peoples will hurry to it.

And many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will show us his way, and we will walk in his paths. For the law will go out from Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem."

And he will judge among many peoples and will rebuke strong nations as far as distant lands. And they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into sickles. Nation will no longer lift up the sword against nation, and they will no longer be eager for war.
And each man will rest under his own vine, and each man under his own fig tree, and there will be no one to make them afraid, for the mouth of the Lord Almighty has spoken this.
For all the peoples walk, each one in his own way, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and beyond.
"In that day," says the Lord, "I will gather those who were crushed, and I will take back those who were driven out, and those whom I had cast away.
And I will make those who were crushed into a remnant, and those who were cast away into a great and strong nation. And the Lord will reign over them in Zion from now on and for ever."
And you, tower of the flock, high daughter of Zion, it will come upon you: the first dominion will enter, that of the king of Babylon, upon the daughter of Jerusalem.
And now, why have you come to know evil? Did you have no king? Has your counsel perished, that pains have seized you like a woman giving birth?

Be in pain and be strong, and draw near, daughter of Zion, like a woman giving birth. For now you will go out of the city and live in the open field, and you will go as far as Babylon. From there he will rescue you, and from there the Lord your God will redeem you from the hands of your enemies.
And now many nations have gathered against you, who say, "We will be satisfied, and our eyes will look upon Zion."
But they did not know the counsel of the Lord, and they did not understand his purposes, for he has gathered them like sheaves on the threshing floor.

Arise and thresh them, daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron, and I will give you hooves of bronze. And you will grind many peoples fine, and with them you will wear down the nations, and you will devote their multitude to the Lord as accursed, and their strength to the Lord of all the earth.
Now the daughter will be hemmed in by a siege; he has laid siege against you. They will strike the tribes of Israel on the cheek with a rod.

And you, Bethlehem, house of Ephrathah, you are small among the thousands of Judah. For out of you will come forth for me a ruler over Israel, who will shepherd my people Israel, and whose goings forth are from the beginning, from the days of eternity.
Therefore he will give them up until the time of the birth. She has given birth, and the remnant of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

And he will stand and see, and the Lord will shepherd his flock with strength, and they will be in the glory of the name of the Lord their God, for now they will be made great as far as the ends of the earth.
And this will be peace: when the Assyrian comes into your land, and when he comes upon your country, seven shepherds and eight wounds of men will rise up against him.
And they will shepherd the Assyrian with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its [?]. And he will rescue you from the Assyrian when he comes into your land and when he enters your borders.

And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, and among many peoples, like dew coming down from the Lord, and like lambs upon the grass, so that no one [?] may gather them, nor may they stand among the sons of men.

And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, and among many peoples, like a lion among the beasts in the forest, and like a lion's whelps among flocks of sheep, in the way that, when it rushes in, it scatters and snatches away, and there is no one to deliver.
Your hand shall be lifted up over your oppressors, and all your enemies shall be destroyed.
And it shall be in that day, says the Lord, that I will destroy your horses from among you, and I will bring your chariots to ruin.
And I will destroy the cities of your land, and I will take away all your strongholds.
And I will wipe out your sorceries from your hand, and there shall be no soothsayers among you.
And I will destroy all your carved images and your pillars from among you, and you shall no longer worship the work of your hands.
And I will cut down the groves from among you, and I will destroy your cities.
And in wrath and anger I will take vengeance among the nations, because they did not listen.
Hear this, what the Lord was saying. The Lord said: Arise and plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
Hear, O hills, the judgment of the Lord, and you valleys, the foundations of the earth, for the Lord has a judgment against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
My people, what have I done to you? Or how have I troubled you? Or how have I wearied you? Answer me a word.
For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and I redeemed you from the house of bondage, and I sent before your face Moses and Aaron and Miriam.

My people, remember what Balak king of Moab plotted against you, and what Balaam son of Beor answered him, from the measuring-cords of the portions as far as Gilgal, so that the righteousness of the Lord may be made known.
How am I to come before the Lord, and become a helper [?] to my God most high? Shall I come before him with sacrifices, or with year-old calves?
Will the Lord accept thousands of rams, or tens of thousands of fattened goats? Shall I give my firstborn for ungodliness, and the fruit of my womb for the sin of my soul?
I will tell you, O man, what is good, or what the Lord seeks from you: only to do justice, and to love mercy, and to be ready to walk with your God.
The voice of the Lord shall call to the city, and he shall save those who fear his name. Hear, O tribes: who will adorn the city?
[?] fire, and the house of the lawless one, who stores up lawless treasures, and falsehood with abomination?
Shall the lawless one be justified by the yoke of the balance, and by the [?] and the deceitful scales,
by which they filled their wealth with ungodliness? And those who dwell in it spoke falsehood, and their tongue was exalted in their mouth.
And I too will afflict you with ruin because of your sin.
You shall eat and not be satisfied, and I will drive you out, and it shall overtake you, and you shall not escape, and as many as escape shall be given over to the sword.
You shall sow and not thresh; you shall press out oil and not anoint yourself with oil; and you shall tread out wine and not drink wine; and the statutes of my people have been destroyed.

and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you walked according to their counsels, so that I might give you over to destruction, and those who dwell in it to hissing; and you shall bear the reproach of the peoples.
Woe is me, for I have become like one who gathers stubble at the threshing, and like the gleaning at the vintage, when there is no cluster to eat, no first fruit. Woe is me, O soul!
For the God-fearing man has perished from the earth, and one who is upright among men is not to be found. They all go to law over blood; each one oppresses his neighbour.
And they make their hands ready for evil. The ruler takes, and the judge spoke words of peace; it is the desire of his soul. And I will take away their wealth.
Like a moth that devours, and that walks by rule on the day of watching. Woe, woe! Your vengeances are coming; now their weeping shall be.
Do not trust friends, and do not hope in rulers. Beware of telling anything [?] to the woman who lies with you.
For the son dishonours the father, and the daughter will rise up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law, and a man's enemies will be the men of his own house.
But I will look to the Lord, and I will wait for God my Saviour, and my God will hear me.
Do not rejoice over me, my enemy, because I have fallen; I will rise again. Though I walked in darkness, the Lord is a light to me.
I will bear the wrath of the Lord, because I sinned against him, until he vindicates my cause and does justice for me, and brings me out into the light, and he will see my righteousness.
And my enemy will see me, and shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is the Lord your God?" My eyes will see her. Now she will be trampled down like mud on the roads.
A day of plastering: like a mud brick he will wipe you out on that day, and that day will remove your law.
And your cities will come to be shut in and divided up by the Assyrians, and your fortified cities to be cut down, from Tyre to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
And the land will be laid waste together with those who live in it, because of the fruits of their deeds.

Shepherd your people with your rod, the sheep of your inheritance, who dwell alone in the forest in the midst of Carmel. Let them graze in the land of the Bashanites and the Gileadites, as in the days of old.
As in the days when you came out of Egypt, you will show them wonders.
The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hands on their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
They will lick the dust like snakes and crawl on the earth. They will tremble in their confinement; they will be amazed at the Lord our God, and they will be afraid of you.
Who is a God like you? You wipe out iniquities and pass over the falsehoods of the remnant of his inheritance. He did not keep his wrath as a testimony, for he is one who delights in mercy.
He will turn again and have mercy on us, and cover our sins, and cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.
He will give truth to Jacob and mercy to Abraham, as he swore to our fathers in the days of old.
